sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
performed every six month as indicated by M6 in the title block. The same 
procedures will be applied for all pumps have the same technical specification 
mentioned at the last page of this document.

Mazout (Screw pump) transfer pump function to transfer mazout from main tank to 
another main tank or to transfer mazout from main tank to daily tank.

The first draft initiated by eng. Emad El din Ali Abd Alla, tested at 16 March 
2004, accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel Karem Aly general director, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, revised by EDEPC 
quality control eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, approved by eng. Mokhter Abd El Latif 
Abu Soltan Power Station Head Sector, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection 
& quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Safety 
 fence with caution marks must be surrounding the work area,

Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker for Motor of this Pump.

Isolate the electrical 
 cable bearing of the motor of this pump

The pump 
 must be isolated mechanically by closing suction and delivery valves 
 and drain it.
